execution_batches.description: Prepare the shared routing model and CDK data shape needed for slot-based dispatch.
Refactor the dispatch runtime to consume one slot at a time and publish phase-2-compatible work items to SQS.
Distribute dispatch across the day with Scheduler and enable SQS FIFO High Throughput settings.
Validate locally and define the AWS proof path for 1M-scale behavior without breaking the phase-2 downstream flow.

tasks.title: Add slot-routing metadata to the pending-record model and shared types
outputs: Shared pending-record shape extended with dispatchDate, dispatchSlot, dispatchSlotPk, and dispatchSortKey
exit_criteria: The codebase has one canonical type contract for phase-3 slot-based dispatch metadata.
The metadata is sufficient to query one date-slot partition without scanning all pending records for a day.
No phase-2 downstream queue contract is changed by this task alone.

tasks.title: Add deterministic dispatch-slot routing and a dispatch-slot-index in CDK
outputs: One deterministic slot-assignment utility and one new DynamoDB GSI for date-slot queries
exit_criteria: A stable hash-based function maps record identity to one slot in the configured slots-per-day range.
tapi-pending-records includes a dispatch-slot-index with partition key dispatchSlotPk and sort key dispatchSortKey.
The technical spec assumption of 288 slots can be expressed as configuration rather than hard-coded business logic.

tasks.title: Refactor the dispatch Lambda input contract to execute one slot at a time
outputs: Dispatch Lambda that accepts slotId, slotsPerDay, and optional targetDate override
exit_criteria: The dispatch Lambda no longer assumes one monolithic daily selection pass.
The Lambda resolves one date-slot partition from scheduler input and derives the matching dispatchSlotPk.
The Lambda returns a structured operational summary with targetDate, slotId, queried, dispatched, and skipped counts.

tasks.title: Implement slot-based DynamoDB querying and pagination for eligible PENDING records
outputs: One dispatch path that queries only the relevant slot partition and paginates through it safely
exit_criteria: The dispatch flow uses the dispatch-slot-index instead of reading the whole day set monolithically.
Only records still in PENDING state are considered eligible for enqueue.
The implementation paginates through a slot partition without silently truncating work.

tasks.title: Batch-publish phase-2-compatible messages to SQS FIFO using provider grouping and recordId deduplication
outputs: Dispatch Lambda publishing SendMessageBatch entries that remain fully compatible with the existing orchestrator and state machine
exit_criteria: SQS publishing uses batches of up to 10 messages.
MessageGroupId is PROVIDER#<providerId> for every message.
MessageDeduplicationId is the original recordId exactly, as approved in the spec.
The queue message body remains phase-2-compatible for orchestrator and Step Functions.

tasks.title: Generate distributed EventBridge Scheduler schedules for all daily dispatch slots
outputs: CDK-defined distributed scheduler topology spanning the full 24-hour window
exit_criteria: The stack defines one recurring schedule per slot across the 24-hour day.
Each schedule invokes the dispatch Lambda with its own slotId and slotsPerDay payload.
Schedule timing reflects the approved distributed-batch-dispatch model rather than a single daily burst.

tasks.title: Enable SQS FIFO High Throughput settings while preserving the phase-2 downstream operational flow
outputs: Provider queue configured for AWS-managed FIFO scaling without custom shuffle-sharding
exit_criteria: The provider queue enables FIFO High Throughput settings with deduplicationScope=messageGroup and fifoThroughputLimit=perMessageGroupId.
Existing DLQ behavior and provider ordering semantics remain intact.
No changes are required in orchestrator, Step Functions, or consumer to accept the new dispatch pattern.

tasks.title: Update local tests and fixtures for slot routing, dispatch payloads, and High Throughput CDK synthesis
outputs: Passing local quality gates for the phase-3 dispatch model
exit_criteria: Tests verify deterministic slot assignment.
Tests verify dispatch Lambda consumes one slot payload and publishes queue messages with MessageGroupId and recordId deduplication.
CDK tests verify dispatch-slot-index, distributed schedules, and SQS FIFO High Throughput settings.
npm run build and relevant Jest suites pass.

tasks.title: Define and execute the AWS validation path for distributed dispatch without breaking phase 2
outputs: A concrete AWS validation checklist for one-slot dispatch, queue behavior, and downstream orchestration compatibility
exit_criteria: Manual validation proves one dispatch invocation reads only one date-slot partition.
Manual validation proves enqueued messages continue flowing through orchestrator and Step Functions without contract changes.
Manual validation covers success, terminal failure, transient exhausted failure, and duplicate protection under the distributed dispatch model.
The project has a defendable narrative for 1M+ scaling using slot partitioning plus SQS FIFO High Throughput.
